# Sales module

Sales is where customer demand enters the plant. A sales clerk takes the customer's order, builds each line from the Product Master, and places it. The order then goes to the planner, who picks the plant and releases each line to the route. From there work centres make the goods, the Packing Yard packs and releases them, and Dispatch Bay ships them. Sales watches the whole journey from one order tracker.

## Screens and how they connect

- **Sales Orders** (`/sales/orders`) – the home page of Sales. Every open order by age and stage. Orders older than 5 days show in red. Filters (status, age, customer, master, Advanced), saved views (kept in this browser), CSV export and cancel before release.
- **New order** (`/sales/orders/create`) – the order composer. Customer → order facts → lines → *Place order*.
- **Sales order tracker** (`/sales/orders/[id]`) – one page per order: spine (Master · Quote · Order · Plan · Floor · Yard · Dispatch), fulfilment figures, line route progress, technical sheet and BOM, documents and material audit.
- **Customer dispatches** (`/sales/orders/[id]/dispatches`, `/new`) – dispatch records against the order lines. Daily slips (one per line, Epson 10×6 in) are made in **Dispatch Bay** (`/logistics/dispatch`); the tracker links to them.
- **Job names** (`/sales/job-names`) – orders grouped by the job name typed in the composer, with ordered, dispatched, open kg and on-time %.
- **Quotations** (`/sales/quotations`, `/new`, `/[id]`) – price an enquiry, cost it, get approval, send the frozen PDF, record the customer's answer and convert to a sales order.
- **Customers** (`/sales/customers`) – customer master: code, name, GST, contacts, addresses, credit terms.
- **Trade Orders** (`/sales/trade-orders`) – resale from stock without production (granules, film, trading goods).
- Old links (`/sales`, `/orders`, `/orders/[id]`, `/orders/create`, `/sales/orders/new`, `.../tracking`) only redirect.

## Main flow: placing an order

1. Open **New order**. Answer *Who is this order for?* (type two letters, arrows + Enter). A draft left in this browser is offered: *Resume draft* or *Start fresh*.
2. Fill the order facts row: Ship to, Promised dispatch (default 7 days ahead, shows "in N days"), Job name (optional, e.g. "ABC May order"), Ship address (blank = saved address) and Note for dispatch (prints on the slip). Plant stays *Auto · planner*.
3. Add lines. In the quick-add row type the product code or name (⌘K), then size, qty, unit (pouches default to pcs) and rate, and press Enter. A product that prints or packs into pouches is added as *Check the line* and must be opened once.
4. Open a line (Enter or *Add line*, Alt N) for the full editor: Product, Size, Layers, Qty & rate, Print & artwork, Packing, Add-ons, More options (lane, trim, wastage). Alt ←/→ moves between lines.
5. Artwork: *Pick approved artwork*, *Use customer overlay* or *Defer to planner*. Deferred artwork lets the order be placed, but print release is blocked until approved artwork is assigned.
6. Open *Before you place* and use *Fix →* on each item. When all is clear press **Place order** (⌘↵).
7. The summary shows the SO number (for example SO-2026-0123), lines, quantity, value and promised date, with *Open order*, *Open in planner*, *New order for …* and *New order*.

## Quotation flow

Draft → Submit for approval (revision and Cost Build freeze) → an approver who is not the submitter approves each gate → Send frozen revision by email (contact email required) → Record acceptance (PO/email reference) or rejection (reason), or Mark expired → Convert to Sales Order (Accepted only). A converted quote cannot be cancelled; cancel the sales order instead. To change a frozen quote, use *Duplicate quotation*.

## After placing

- The planner releases lines; the order tracker's spine moves Plan → Floor.
- Inner pouches are never ticked in the Packing Yard. In-house inner pouches come off stock at the machine's last pouching step when the output is logged; bought inner pouches are booked to the order by the evening packing count. Gonny, sheet/putha, box, tape, label, tag, outer bag and other items are ticked at release as marks and booked by the evening packing count, which splits the use over the orders that ticked them in whole pieces (if no one ticked an item, over that day's orders whose packing plan includes it).
- Dispatch Bay makes one slip per sales-order line, marks it dispatched and records proof of delivery. The order becomes COMPLETED only when proof of delivery (POD) is confirmed for every line; marking a slip dispatched does not complete it.
- Goods of a closed line or order (short-closed, completed, cancelled) can ship only after ticking *Send goods of closed lines*, or be moved to free stock with a reason.

## Rules and limits

- Sales can cancel an order only before planner release (Draft, Confirmed, Planning, Planned). Released lines are cancelled or short-closed in the Planner.
- Every line needs a product master, a size, qty > 0 and a rate > 0. Printed lines need approved artwork matching the print method (Roto/Flexo) and sheet/tubing form, unless deferred.
- Drafts autosave only in the browser where they were typed.
- Promised dispatch is required. The plant is never picked by Sales.
- Trade orders consume stock at the chosen plant when dispatched; this cannot be undone.

## Roles

- **SALES**: customers, quotations, orders, job names, trade orders, tracking.
- **OWNER / ADMIN / SUPER_ADMIN**: everything Sales does plus product masters.
- **PLANNER**: receives placed orders in the plan queue; cancels or short-closes released lines.
- **DISPATCH**: Dispatch Bay slips; may view customer dispatch records.
- Quotation approval needs a second authorised user.

## Problems and fixes

- *Place order is grey*: open the warning pill or *Before you place*; fix each line ("Needs rate", "Needs artwork", "Check the line").
- *Product master unavailable*: the master is inactive or an old version. Remove the line and add the current master.
- *Draft lost*: drafts live in one browser; reopen New order on the same PC and press *Resume draft*.
- *Cannot cancel the order*: it is released; ask the planner to short-close.
- *Dispatch refused – not ready*: release the goods in the Packing Yard first; partial lines ship only finished output.
- *Quote cannot be approved by me*: the submitter cannot approve their own revision.
- *Customer missing in the composer*: add it in Customers and refresh.

# Sales module

Sales वह जगह है जहाँ ग्राहक की माँग plant में आती है। sales clerk ग्राहक का order लेता है, Product Master से हर line बनाता है और order डालता है। फिर order planner के पास जाता है, जो plant चुनता है और हर line route पर release करता है। उसके बाद work centre माल बनाते हैं, Packing Yard pack करके release करता है, और Dispatch Bay माल भेजता है। Sales पूरा सफर एक order tracker पर देखता है।

## Screens और उनका आपसी जुड़ाव

- **Sales Orders** (`/sales/orders`) – Sales का मुख्य page। हर खुला order उम्र और stage के हिसाब से। 5 दिन से पुराने orders लाल में। filter (status, उम्र, ग्राहक, master, Advanced), saved views (इसी browser में), CSV export और release से पहले cancel।
- **New order** (`/sales/orders/create`) – order composer। ग्राहक → order की जानकारी → lines → *Place order*।
- **Sales order tracker** (`/sales/orders/[id]`) – हर order का एक page: spine (Master · Quote · Order · Plan · Floor · Yard · Dispatch), कितना बना/गया, line का route, technical sheet और BOM, documents और material audit।
- **Customer dispatches** (`/sales/orders/[id]/dispatches`, `/new`) – order lines पर dispatch record। रोज़ की slips (हर line की एक, Epson 10×6 inch) **Dispatch Bay** (`/logistics/dispatch`) में बनती हैं; tracker से वहाँ link है।
- **Job names** (`/sales/job-names`) – composer में लिखे job name के हिसाब से orders, ordered, dispatched, open kg और समय पर पूरे होने के % के साथ।
- **Quotations** (`/sales/quotations`, `/new`, `/[id]`) – enquiry का भाव, costing, approval, frozen PDF भेजना, ग्राहक का जवाब दर्ज करना और sales order में convert।
- **Customers** (`/sales/customers`) – ग्राहक master: code, नाम, GST, contact, पते, credit शर्तें।
- **Trade Orders** (`/sales/trade-orders`) – बिना production के stock से बिक्री (granules, film, trading goods)।
- पुराने links (`/sales`, `/orders`, `/orders/[id]`, `/orders/create`, `/sales/orders/new`, `.../tracking`) सिर्फ आगे भेजते हैं।

## मुख्य काम: order डालना

1. **New order** खोलें। *Who is this order for?* का जवाब दें (दो अक्षर लिखें, तीर और Enter)। इस browser में छूटा draft हो तो *Resume draft* या *Start fresh* चुनें।
2. order facts वाली row भरें: Ship to, Promised dispatch (default 7 दिन बाद, "in N days" दिखता है), Job name (ज़रूरी नहीं, जैसे "ABC May order"), Ship address (खाली = saved पता) और Note for dispatch (slip पर छपता है)। Plant *Auto · planner* ही रहता है।
3. lines जोड़ें। quick-add row में product का code या नाम (⌘K), फिर size, qty, unit (pouch default pcs) और rate भरकर Enter दबाएँ। जो product print होता है या pouch में pack होता है वह *Check the line* के साथ जुड़ता है और उसे एक बार खोलना ज़रूरी है।
4. पूरा editor के लिए line खोलें (Enter या *Add line*, Alt N): Product, Size, Layers, Qty & rate, Print & artwork, Packing, Add-ons, More options (lane, trim, wastage)। Alt ←/→ से lines बदलें।
5. Artwork: *Pick approved artwork*, *Use customer overlay* या *Defer to planner*। planner पर छोड़ने से order डल जाता है, पर approved artwork मिलने तक print release रुका रहता है।
6. *Before you place* खोलें और हर कमी पर *Fix →* दबाएँ। सब ठीक होने पर **Place order** (⌘↵) दबाएँ।
7. सारांश में SO number (जैसे SO-2026-0123), lines, मात्रा, कीमत और वादे की तारीख दिखती है, साथ में *Open order*, *Open in planner*, *New order for …* और *New order*।

## Quotation का क्रम

Draft → Submit for approval (revision और Cost Build freeze) → submit करने वाले से अलग approver हर gate approve करता है → Send frozen revision email से (contact email ज़रूरी) → Record acceptance (PO/email reference) या rejection (कारण), या Mark expired → Convert to Sales Order (सिर्फ Accepted)। convert हुई quote cancel नहीं होती; उसकी जगह sales order cancel करें। freeze quote बदलनी हो तो *Duplicate quotation* करें।

## Order डालने के बाद

- planner lines release करता है; tracker की spine Plan → Floor पर बढ़ती है।
- Packing Yard में inner pouch कभी tick नहीं होते। घर में बने (in-house) inner pouch मशीन के आखिरी pouching step पर output दर्ज होते ही stock से घटते हैं; खरीदे हुए inner pouch शाम की packing गिनती order पर बुक करती है। gonny, sheet/putha, box, tape, label, tag, outer bag और बाकी सामान release पर सिर्फ tick (निशान) होते हैं और शाम की packing गिनती में बुक होते हैं, जो इस्तेमाल को tick करने वाले orders में पूरे नग के हिसाब से बाँटती है (किसी ने tick न किया हो तो उस दिन के उन orders में जिनके packing plan में वह item है)।
- Dispatch Bay हर sales-order line की एक slip बनाता है, dispatch mark करता है और proof of delivery दर्ज करता है। हर line का proof of delivery (POD) confirm होने पर ही order COMPLETED होता है; slip को dispatched mark करने से order पूरा नहीं होता।
- बंद line या order (short-closed, completed, cancelled) का माल सिर्फ *Send goods of closed lines* tick करने के बाद जा सकता है, या कारण के साथ free stock में डाला जा सकता है।

## नियम और सीमाएँ

- Sales सिर्फ planner release से पहले order cancel कर सकता है (Draft, Confirmed, Planning, Planned)। release हुई lines Planner में cancel या short-close होती हैं।
- हर line में product master, size, qty > 0 और rate > 0 चाहिए। printed line को print तरीके (Roto/Flexo) और sheet/tubing form से मेल खाता approved artwork चाहिए, जब तक planner पर न छोड़ा हो।
- draft सिर्फ उसी browser में save होता है जहाँ लिखा गया।
- Promised dispatch ज़रूरी है। plant Sales कभी नहीं चुनता।
- trade order dispatch होने पर चुने plant से stock घटता है; यह वापस नहीं होता।

## Roles

- **SALES**: customers, quotations, orders, job names, trade orders, tracking।
- **OWNER / ADMIN / SUPER_ADMIN**: Sales का सब काम और product masters।
- **PLANNER**: डाले गए orders plan queue में लेता है; release हुई lines cancel या short-close करता है।
- **DISPATCH**: Dispatch Bay की slips; customer dispatch record देख सकता है।
- quotation approval के लिए दूसरा अधिकृत user चाहिए।

## समस्याएँ और हल

- *Place order grey है*: चेतावनी pill या *Before you place* खोलें; हर line ठीक करें ("Needs rate", "Needs artwork", "Check the line")।
- *Product master unavailable*: master inactive है या पुराना version। line हटाकर नया master जोड़ें।
- *Draft खो गया*: draft एक ही browser में रहता है; उसी PC पर New order खोलकर *Resume draft* दबाएँ।
- *Order cancel नहीं हो रहा*: order release हो चुका; planner से short-close करवाएँ।
- *Dispatch मना – not ready*: पहले Packing Yard में माल release करें; partial line में सिर्फ तैयार माल जाता है।
- *मैं quote approve नहीं कर पा रहा*: submit करने वाला अपनी revision approve नहीं कर सकता।
- *Composer में ग्राहक नहीं*: Customers में जोड़ें और page refresh करें।

# Dashboards

Every role lands on its own dashboard after login. A dashboard shows live numbers and links; the real work is done on the pages it links to. If a data feed fails, a dashboard shows "—", "Unavailable" or a "paused" message instead of zeros, so a zero on screen is always a real zero.

## Which dashboard opens for whom
- **Admin / Super Admin** → System Admin Console (`/dashboard/admin`).
- **Owner** → Owner dashboard (`/dashboard/owner`).
- **Sales** → Sales Command Center (`/dashboard/sales`).
- **Planner** → Planner Command Center (`/dashboard/planner`).
- **Work Center Manager** → WC terminal (`/production/work-center`); the Command Deck is `/dashboard/work-center`.
- **Operator** → Machine terminal (`/production/machine-selector`). `/dashboard/operator` is an old address that redirects there.
- **Store** → Rolls; the Inventory Control Hub is `/dashboard/inventory`.
- **Dispatch** → Total Logistics Hub (`/dashboard/logistics`).
- **Plant Manager** → KPIs. **Watchman** → Gate terminal.
- `/dashboard` itself has no screen; it sends you to `/`, which opens your role's page.

## The screens
**Owner dashboard.** Money, output, stock and risk for a chosen timeframe (day, week, month, year): booked order value, gross margin, production output, overdue orders, inventory, scrap, machine utilisation and actual-cost coverage. Panels: Profit & loss, Six-month financials, Order book health (Draft, Needs planning, Packing ready, Dispatch ready), Top customers, SKU Performance, Stock position, Job status, Material discipline, Ink control, POD Intelligence, Route Reuse Pools, Procurement, Trading, Live floor activity, Shift output & quality, and Alerts & risk signals. Each links to its report.

**System Admin Console.** Active users, error rate, database latency and size, CPU / memory / disk, department sign-off (approved vs pending, with "Open Governance Console"), maintenance ("Clear application cache", "Vacuum…" then "Run vacuum now") and the system event stream.

**Sales Command Center.** Order value (30 days), open pipeline, On time in full, overdue orders, Orders today, Drafts to confirm, Ready to ship, Quote conversion, the 30-day intake chart (Weight / Orders), Needs attention, Order pipeline, Top customers, Products by value, Recent orders and Most overdue. "Create order" starts a new order.

**Inventory Control Hub.** Bulk stock, rolls on hand, finished goods, open alerts, available vs reserved rolls, aged stock (90d+), stock value, stock aging, by stage, by location, by plant, largest families and the Critical action centre. Links: "Create GRN", "Health diagnostics", "All alerts".

**Total Logistics Hub.** Pending Challans (drafts), Dispatch Ready (orders with FG), Vehicles Loading/Transit, Shipped Today, Challan Flow Distribution and the latest slips. "Open Dispatch Bay" leads to the working page.

**Engineering Hub.** Pending Artworks (draft / approval), Cylinder Attention (maintenance / re-chrome), Templates To Finish (not live), Live Templates with active routes, an Approvals Queue with "Review", and Catalog Health (cylinder-ready artworks, templates with a route).

**Work Center Command Deck.** For the WC manager: active work centers, executing and blocked jobs, machines running, released jobs with no machine, output, scrap rate and runtime coverage; risk donuts; escalations with filters; a board per work center with "Open terminal"; machine readiness; execution discipline (downtime, ink remix, cost coverage, unmapped cost); recent floor activity; and a Shift Handoff checklist. It refreshes every 60 seconds.

## How the dashboards connect to the plant flow
1. Sales books an order (Sales dashboard → Create order) and confirms it. Drafts never reach the planner.
2. The planner sees it on the Planner dashboard and works it in the Control Tower.
3. Engineering approves artworks and makes templates LIVE (Engineering Hub shows what is pending).
4. The WC manager runs released jobs (Command Deck → WC terminal), operators log output on the Machine terminal.
5. Packing Yard releases goods; Dispatch prints one slip per order line (Logistics Hub → Dispatch Bay).
6. The owner watches money, output and risk on the Owner dashboard.

## Rules and limits
- Dashboards are read-only except the admin maintenance buttons.
- Numbers come from live feeds; most refresh on open or with "Refresh". The WC deck refreshes every 60 s.
- A role sees only the menu entries it may use; the server refuses data a role may not read.

## Problems and fixes
- **Tiles show "—" or "Unavailable".** The feed failed. Press "Retry" / "Refresh". Other screens keep working.
- **"System health did not respond."** Retry; the rest of the ERP is unaffected.
- **Reports show old numbers.** Admin presses "Clear application cache".
- **Wrong dashboard opens.** You are on another role; switch role from the profile menu.
- **Owner panel empty.** Change the timeframe; "day" is often empty early in the shift.
- **Sales dashboard missing from the Sales sidebar.** It is the Sales landing page; open it from the Orders workspace tab "Sales dashboard".

## dashboard और plant का काम कैसे जुड़ते हैं

# Planner and the Control Tower

The planner turns confirmed sales-order lines into released production jobs, decides where material comes from, and watches the lines until they close. The planner lands on the **Planner Command Center** (`/dashboard/planner`) and works in the **Control Tower**, which has seven tabs. Keys **1–7** switch tabs when the cursor is not in a field.

| Key | Tab | Route | What it is for |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Command | `/dashboard/planner/control-tower/command` | What to act on now: top 5 at-risk orders, source mix, demand, job states, WC load, action desk, output, recent movement |
| 2 | Plan Queue | `.../plan-queue` | One row per order line: gates, artwork, source choice, release, short-close, cancel |
| 3 | Live Production | `.../live-production` | Released and running lines, machines now, today's timeline, replan, color revision |
| 4 | Completed Trace | `.../completed-trace` | Closed lines, cycle time, on-time, stock claims, trace gaps, CSV export |
| 5 | Material readiness | `.../stock-intelligence` | Stock vs demand per template, quick stock launch, packaging and POD in-house |
| 6 | Combine Orders | `.../gang-builder` | Put several roll-output jobs of one Product Master on one jumbo |
| 7 | Launch Stock | `.../stock-launcher` | Make-to-stock orders on any product master |

## Main flow: releasing a sales line
1. Sales confirms the order (drafts never appear in the queue).
2. In **Plan Queue**, find the line (chips All, Ready, Blocked, Artwork, Overdue, Aged 30d+, New ≤3d; search; Filters; sort Newest / Due first / Largest) and click it.
3. Read the four gates: **S** Spec math, **M** Material (recipe/BOM), **A** Artwork, **R** Route. Each gate shows only its own check. An artwork-only line is amber "Artwork pending", not "Blocked". Material is red only when the recipe/BOM is not production-ready.
4. If printing: press "Assign artwork" and pick an APPROVED artwork (filtered by product master, size, print type and sheet/tube form).
5. Press "Plan & Release" (or "Choose source & release" when finished goods or WIP match). Pick the source: **FG match** (ship from finished stock), **Carry WIP**, **Invariant stock**, **Input stock** (pre-selected for WCM at the first roll-input step) or **Fresh run**. Enter "KG to allocate" or press MAX.
6. Under "Route dispatch" choose a work center for each planner-decided step; optionally skip an optional route step.
7. Keep "Release immediately after planning" ticked and press "Plan & Release", or untick for "Plan only". The toast says "Order planned & released".
8. Jobs appear in the WC terminal; follow them in Live Production; closed lines move to Completed Trace.

## Rolls and web width
- A roll is used as it is within **±20 mm** of the planned web. Wider rolls are slit, or allocated by manual override with a reason. Narrower than −20 mm is refused.
- Before a slitting step, a multi-lane (n-up) line runs its planned parent web (lanes × child + trim). Example: a 3-up 230 mm line on a 700 mm web accepts 680–720 mm rolls at printing.
- The spec card shows **Stock web**, e.g. "Open web · 655 mm roll · slit allowed".

## Short-close and cancel
- **Cancel line**: only before any machine, material or scrap activity. After that the server says "Line has machine activity. Use short-close for the remaining quantity."
- **Short close**: keeps what was produced and closes only the remaining quantity.
- Both need a reason of at least 5 characters; it is kept in the audit trail.
- Goods already made for a closed line stay in the yard. Dispatch Bay either ships them (after ticking "Send goods of closed lines") or moves them to free stock with a reason; the planner can then use them as FG match for any order of the same spec.
- **Replan**: when the final step made less than the target, dispatch can ship what was made and the balance waits in the queue for re-release or short-close.

## Print color revision
After release and before completion, "Revise colors only" changes ink names (with a reason). Artwork, route, dimensions, print method and color counts stay locked. WCM and the machine show old and new colors.

## Stock: Material readiness and Launch Stock
- Material readiness marks templates SHORT, TIGHT, COVERED, OVERSTOCK or STOCK READY. "Build & release" opens a quick launcher (quantity in KG, "Send straight to production").
- Launch Stock: pick a product master, commitment (Generic pool, Customer, Artwork, Customer + art), where the route stops (finished stock or WIP pool), size and layers, quantity; press "Validate pool", clear blockers, then create. Stock orders skip the release gate and the artwork gate; the first job is released at once.

## Combine Orders
Only jobs with the same Product Master, film stack, step and process, at a roll-output step and with a target width, can be combined. Tick 2 or more and press "Combine". Slitting happens at the WC terminal, one slit child per job, 5 mm trimmed at each cut.

## Roles
Planner, Plant Manager, Owner, Admin and Super Admin can open the Control Tower. Only the Planner or an authorised administrator can revise released print colors.

## Problems and fixes
- **"Artwork assignment is required before release for printing-enabled order."** Assign artwork first.
- **"Artwork must be APPROVED before assignment."** Engineering must approve it.
- **"Release is blocked until every planner-decided route step has a work center."** Fill Route dispatch.
- **"Plan saved; release pending."** Press "Retry release"; do not plan again.
- **"Plan not confirmed."** Press "Confirm saved plan"; the same plan is recovered.
- **"Saved; queue refresh pending."** Press "Retry saved queue" or "Refresh"; do not submit again.
- **"An earlier plan needs confirmation."** Resume it from the banner.
- **Red Material gate.** Fix the recipe/BOM on the product master.
- **Combine refused.** The message names the mismatch (Product Master, step, width, roll output).
- **Stock launch refused: "Template must be the current LIVE version for Stock Order creation".** Make the template LIVE.

# Planner module — production-side screens

The main planner work is in the **Planner Control Tower** (/dashboard/planner/control-tower/...): Command, Plan queue, Live production, Completed trace, Material readiness, Combine orders and Launch stock. This document covers the production-side planner addresses and how they fit.

## Screens

- **/production** and **/production/planner** — old addresses. Both forward to the Control Tower "Command" tab. The "Jobs" tab of the Floor workspace also points to /production.
- **/production/planner/stock-launcher** — old address of the stock launcher; forwards to the Control Tower "Launch stock" tab and keeps the link query.
- **/production/planner/gang-builder** — "Combine orders". The same screen is the Control Tower "Combine orders" tab.
- **/production/planner/heatmap** — "Factory Heatmap / Capacity". Load per work centre.
- **/production/planning** — "Production Planning Board". An older board of jobs by state.

## Flow: combine orders onto one jumbo roll

1. Several orders of one Product Master and film recipe are released and wait at the same roll-making step (printing, lamination, slitting). Example: three ABC Foods lines, 230, 240 and 250 mm wide.
2. Open Combine orders. Groups are formed by Product Master + recipe + route step. A group is "combinable" only when it has at least 2 open orders, one Product Master, target widths on every order and a roll-output step.
3. Pick the group, tick 2 or more orders. The slit preview shows one block per order and the jumbo width: sum of widths + 5 mm trimmed at each cut (here 730 mm).
4. Press "Combine N orders". The orders get one gang batch id.
5. At the WC terminal the roll picker creates one slit child per order from one jumbo.

## Flow: check capacity before releasing

1. Open the heatmap. Each tile is a work centre. Load = running jobs ÷ machines × 100.
2. Red tiles (over 85%) are at risk; "Critical Contention" suggests holding new releases there.
3. "Optimal Slot" names the lightest work centre; route work there only if the template permits.
4. Release from the plan queue; follow running jobs in Live production.

## Planning board

The planning board lists jobs under Planned, Released, In Progress (running and paused) and Completed. It can release a planned job, split a planned job ("New Job Quantity (Split Off)"; the rest stays), change the priority number (lower runs first), put a released job on hold, and resume a paused job. Normal line release with stock and route checks is in the plan queue.

## Rules and limits

- Release in the plan queue waits for four gates: Spec, Material, Artwork, Route.
- Only PLANNED or WAITING jobs can be released; only PLANNED jobs can be split; split quantity must be less than the job quantity.
- Combining needs the same Product Master, the same step, roll output and a target width on every order.
- Rolls are allocated within ±20 mm of the planned web; lanes (n-up) decide the run web before slitting.
- Goods of a closed line can be moved to free stock with a reason; the planner can then claim them for another order of the same specification.

## Who does what

- **PLANNER**: combine orders, read capacity, use the planning board, release lines in the plan queue.
- **PLANT_MANAGER**: same views; checks load and holds.
- **ADMIN / OWNER / SUPER_ADMIN**: everything.
- **WORK_CENTER_MANAGER** makes the slits for combined orders on the WC terminal.

## Problems and fixes

- **No combinable groups** — orders differ in Product Master, recipe, step or width. Fix the line width or wait for more orders.
- **"Selected jobs must be at the same route step and process …"** — jobs moved on; press Refresh.
- **Heatmap shows 0% everywhere** — no job is running, or the work centres have no machines.
- **"Can only release PLANNED or WAITING jobs."** — the job already moved on; refresh.
- **"Emergency reason is required for EMERGENCY jobwork."** — "Detour to Job Work" on the planning board sends no reason; use Inventory › Job work.
- **Old link opens the Control Tower** — that is expected; update the bookmark.

# Planner मॉड्यूल — production की तरफ़ की स्क्रीन

Planner का मुख्य काम **Planner Control Tower** (/dashboard/planner/control-tower/...) में होता है: Command, Plan queue, Live production, Completed trace, Material readiness, Combine orders और Launch stock। यह दस्तावेज़ production की तरफ़ के planner पते और उनका संबंध बताता है।

## स्क्रीन

- **/production** और **/production/planner** — पुराने पते। दोनों Control Tower के "Command" टैब पर भेजते हैं। Floor workspace का "Jobs" टैब भी /production पर जाता है।
- **/production/planner/stock-launcher** — stock launcher का पुराना पता; Control Tower के "Launch stock" टैब पर भेजता है, लिंक की query साथ रहती है।
- **/production/planner/gang-builder** — "Combine orders"। यही स्क्रीन Control Tower का "Combine orders" टैब है।
- **/production/planner/heatmap** — "Factory Heatmap / Capacity"। हर work centre का लोड।
- **/production/planning** — "Production Planning Board"। स्थिति के अनुसार jobs का पुराना board।

## क्रम: कई orders को एक jumbo roll पर जोड़ना

1. एक ही Product Master और film recipe के कई orders रिलीज़ होकर एक ही roll बनाने वाले step (printing, lamination, slitting) पर रुके हैं। जैसे ABC Foods की तीन lines, 230, 240 और 250 mm चौड़ी।
2. Combine orders खोलें। Groups Product Master + recipe + route step से बनते हैं। Group तभी "combinable" है जब उसमें कम से कम 2 खुले orders हों, एक Product Master हो, हर order की target चौड़ाई हो और step roll बनाता हो।
3. Group चुनें, 2 या ज़्यादा orders टिक करें। slit preview हर order का एक ब्लॉक और jumbo की चौड़ाई दिखाता है: चौड़ाइयों का जोड़ + हर कट पर 5 mm (यहाँ 730 mm)।
4. "Combine N orders" दबाएँ। orders को एक gang batch id मिलता है।
5. WC terminal पर roll picker एक jumbo से हर order का एक slit child बनाता है।

## क्रम: रिलीज़ से पहले क्षमता देखना

1. Heatmap खोलें। हर टाइल एक work centre है। लोड = चल रहे jobs ÷ machines × 100।
2. लाल टाइल (85% से ऊपर) जोखिम में हैं; "Critical Contention" वहाँ नई रिलीज़ रोकने को कहता है।
3. "Optimal Slot" सबसे खाली work centre बताता है; template अनुमति दे तभी वहाँ काम भेजें।
4. रिलीज़ plan queue से करें; चल रहे jobs Live production में देखें।

## Planning board

Planning board jobs को Planned, Released, In Progress (चल रहे और रुके) और Completed में दिखाता है। इससे planned job रिलीज़ कर सकते हैं, planned job split कर सकते हैं ("New Job Quantity (Split Off)"; बाकी मूल job पर रहता है), priority नंबर बदल सकते हैं (छोटा पहले चलता है), released job को hold कर सकते हैं, और रुके job को resume कर सकते हैं। स्टॉक और route जाँच के साथ line की सामान्य रिलीज़ plan queue में होती है।

## नियम और सीमाएँ

- Plan queue में रिलीज़ चार गेट का इंतज़ार करती है: Spec, Material, Artwork, Route।
- केवल PLANNED या WAITING job रिलीज़ होते हैं; केवल PLANNED job split होते हैं; split मात्रा job की मात्रा से कम हो।
- जोड़ने के लिए एक Product Master, एक step, roll output और हर order की target चौड़ाई चाहिए।
- Rolls planned web से ±20 mm के भीतर लगते हैं; slitting से पहले lanes (n-up) run web तय करती हैं।
- बंद line का माल कारण के साथ free stock में जा सकता है; फिर planner उसे उसी specification के दूसरे order के लिए claim कर सकता है।

## कौन क्या करता है

- **PLANNER**: orders जोड़ना, क्षमता देखना, planning board, plan queue में रिलीज़।

- **"Emergency reason is required for EMERGENCY jobwork."** — planning board का "Detour to Job Work" कारण नहीं भेजता; Inventory › Job work इस्तेमाल करें।

# Production module (floor execution)

The Production module is where released order lines are actually made. It covers the **WC terminal** (work-centre manager), the **Machine terminal** (operator), the **Ink Control Desk**, and the read-only **Production job** summary. Planning screens (plan queue, combine orders, launch stock) are in the Planner module.

## Screens and how they connect

- **/production/work-center** — "Choose your machine group". A work-centre manager (WCM) sees only the work centres assigned to them. The last one used is remembered.
- **/production/work-center/[id]** — "Work Center Terminal". The queue of order lines at this work centre, and a job pane to prepare and release each job.
- **/production/machine-selector** — "Choose your machine". The operator's home. An operator sees only the machines assigned to them; with one machine the terminal opens straight away.
- **/production/machine/[machine_id]** — "Machine Terminal". Start, log output, pause, complete.
- **/production/ink-control** — "Ink Control Desk". Issue, return and count ink on the floor; reconcile with artwork theory.
- **/production/jobs/[id]** — read-only job summary with links to the terminals and trace.

## Main flow: from planner release to machine output

1. The planner releases an order line to its route in the Control Tower plan queue. Jobs are created for the route steps.
2. The line appears in the queue of the first work centre, e.g. ABC Foods, SO-2026-0123, printing.
3. The WCM opens the job. The job pane shows: **Order · what it is** (ordered, produced, remaining, the "what is to be made" plate), **Machine**, **Rolls by lane**, **Input issue**, and **Release · readiness**.
4. The WCM taps the machine. A machine already running another order is refused unless it may run several orders (extrusion by default).
5. The WCM assigns rolls with the roll picker: scan or type the roll ID, or pick from the list. A roll within **±20 mm** of the planned web is used as it is; a wider roll is slit; a roll more than 20 mm narrower is refused. Before slitting, a multi-lane line runs its planned parent web (lanes × child width + trim).
6. In Input issue only **rolls and granule grade codes** are entered by hand. Every other material shows "Auto · step mapping" and is issued at its planned quantity. A granule can be split over several grade codes; release waits until every issued kg has a code.
7. When the gates M (machine), R (rolls), I (issue) and C (cylinders/artwork) are clear, the WCM presses **Release to machine**.
8. The operator opens the machine terminal, picks the job in the Queue rail and presses **Start**.
9. The operator logs output: roll rows (gross, core tare, width, length), pieces on pouching, or split child rolls on slitting; plus trim and scrap. Then **Log output**.
10. When the step is done the operator presses **Complete**. If output is short of the target the button reads **Force complete** and a variance reason is needed.
11. The next route step can now run on what was logged. Parallel steps (e.g. extrusion and printing feeding lamination) may run at the same time. Finished pouches go to the Packing Yard; finished rolls go to packing and dispatch.

## Rules and limits

- One order per machine at a time, except bulk-to-roll steps (extrusion) or machines set to allow several orders. Start and Resume both check this.
- Wastage: if trim + scrap is at or above the company limit (Company profile, default 5%), a wastage reason and a note are required.
- Output is capped by the rolls loaded; on lamination the tightest lane sets the cap. A lane may run up to 5% short of its share; past that the operator or WCM must load the next roll.
- A part-used roll leaves a job only through **Return balance** (back to stock with the same label; a lower weighed balance is booked as scrap) or **Roll finished** (core end booked as scrap). An untouched roll can simply be taken off.
- Pause always asks a reason bucket (Machine breakdown, Maintenance, Material shortage, Manpower shortage, Power failure, Other) and writes a downtime record. "Other" needs a note.
- At the last pouching step, logging the output takes in-house inner pouches off stock (by count, or by weight for inner pouches stocked in KG). Bought inner pouches are only marked here; they and every other packing item are booked by the evening packing count. The inner pouch setup never stops an output: with no pieces per inner pouch the output is still saved, the Packing Yard enters "Inner packs filled" and the evening count books them.
- After release, preparation on the WC terminal is locked. "Recalculate from masters" works only before any output is logged.

## Ink control

Ink is not a job requirement. It is issued from the store to a floor location, returned or returned as mix (POLY or PET base), and counted on the floor by time. Actual use = opening count + issued − returned − closing count. The Reconcile tab spreads that use over the jobs printed in the window and compares it with the artwork GSM theory.

## Who does what

- **WORK_CENTER_MANAGER**: WC terminal — machine, rolls, granule codes, release, add next roll, close short, cancel. Also the machine terminal.
- **OPERATOR**: machine terminal only — start, log output, pause, complete, return or finish a roll.
- **PLANNER / PLANT_MANAGER**: may view floor screens, ink control, job summaries.
- **ADMIN / OWNER / SUPER_ADMIN**: everything.

## Problems and fixes

- **"No Machines Assigned"** — the account has no machine or work centre. An admin assigns one on System › Users.
- **Start is off** — input rolls are not reserved. Ask the WCM.
- **"Machine not assigned. WCM must assign a machine before execution."** — the job was not released to a machine.
- **"… is running JOB-…"** — pause or finish the other order first.
- **Wastage reason required** — choose a reason under Trim and scrap and write why.
- **"Load the next roll for this lane first."** — a lane is short; add the next roll.
- **"Selected roll width is outside the planned web ±20 mm …"** — pick another roll, slit a wider one, or use the override with a reason.
- **"Code split for … must total …"** — grade codes must add up to the issued kg.
- **Yellow "Output logged · one thing left for the store"** — the output is saved; the store or the evening count settles the stock note.

# Production मॉड्यूल (फ्लोर पर उत्पादन)

Production मॉड्यूल में रिलीज़ हुई order lines असल में बनती हैं। इसमें **WC terminal** (work-centre manager), **Machine terminal** (operator), **Ink Control Desk**, और केवल देखने वाला **Production job** सार है। प्लानिंग की स्क्रीन (plan queue, combine orders, launch stock) Planner मॉड्यूल में हैं।

## स्क्रीन और उनका आपसी संबंध

- **/production/work-center** — "Choose your machine group"। WCM को केवल उसे दिए गए work centres दिखते हैं। पिछली बार वाला याद रहता है।
- **/production/work-center/[id]** — "Work Center Terminal"। इस work centre की order lines की कतार, और हर job तैयार करके रिलीज़ करने का पैनल।
- **/production/machine-selector** — "Choose your machine"। Operator का होम। Operator को केवल उसकी machines दिखती हैं; एक ही machine हो तो terminal सीधे खुलता है।
- **/production/machine/[machine_id]** — "Machine Terminal"। Start, output लिखना, pause, complete।
- **/production/ink-control** — "Ink Control Desk"। फ्लोर पर ink देना, वापस लेना, गिनना; artwork theory से मिलान।
- **/production/jobs/[id]** — job का सार, terminals और trace के लिंक के साथ।

## मुख्य क्रम: planner की रिलीज़ से machine के output तक

1. Planner, Control Tower के plan queue में order line को route पर रिलीज़ करता है। route steps के jobs बनते हैं।
2. Line पहले work centre की कतार में आती है, जैसे ABC Foods, SO-2026-0123, printing।
3. WCM job खोलता है। पैनल में: **Order · what it is** (ordered, produced, remaining, "what is to be made" प्लेट), **Machine**, **Rolls by lane**, **Input issue**, और **Release · readiness**।
4. WCM machine चुनता है। जो machine दूसरा order चला रही है वह मना होती है, जब तक उसे कई orders की अनुमति न हो (default में extrusion)।
5. WCM roll picker से rolls लगाता है: roll ID स्कैन करें या लिखें, या सूची से चुनें। planned web से **±20 mm** के भीतर का roll वैसे ही चलता है; चौड़ा roll slit होता है; 20 mm से ज़्यादा पतला roll मना है। slitting से पहले, कई lane वाली line planned parent web चलाती है (lanes × child चौड़ाई + trim)।
6. Input issue में केवल **rolls और granule के grade code** हाथ से भरते हैं। बाकी हर सामग्री "Auto · step mapping" दिखाती है और योजना की मात्रा पर issue होती है। एक granule कई grade code में बँट सकता है; हर issued kg को कोड मिलने तक रिलीज़ रुकती है।
7. गेट M (machine), R (rolls), I (issue) और C (cylinders/artwork) साफ़ हों तो WCM **Release to machine** दबाता है।
8. Operator machine terminal खोलता है, Queue में job चुनता है और **Start** दबाता है।
9. Operator output लिखता है: roll की पंक्तियाँ (gross, core tare, चौड़ाई, लंबाई), pouching में pieces, या slitting में child rolls; साथ में trim और scrap। फिर **Log output**।
10. Step पूरा होने पर **Complete** दबाता है। output लक्ष्य से कम हो तो बटन **Force complete** बनता है और कारण लिखना पड़ता है।
11. अब अगला route step दर्ज output पर चल सकता है। समानांतर steps (जैसे extrusion और printing, जो lamination को माल देते हैं) एक साथ चल सकते हैं। तैयार pouches Packing Yard जाते हैं; तैयार rolls packing और dispatch पर।

## नियम और सीमाएँ

- एक machine पर एक समय में एक order, सिवाय bulk-to-roll steps (extrusion) या जिन machines को कई orders की अनुमति है। Start और Resume दोनों पर यह जाँच होती है।
- वेस्टेज: trim + scrap कंपनी सीमा (Company profile, default 5%) के बराबर या ऊपर हो तो कारण और टिप्पणी ज़रूरी।
- Output लोड rolls से सीमित है; lamination में सबसे कम lane सीमा तय करती है। एक lane अपने हिस्से से 5% तक कम चल सकती है; उससे ज़्यादा हो तो अगला roll लोड करना होगा।
- आधा इस्तेमाल हुआ roll job से केवल **Return balance** (उसी लेबल के साथ स्टॉक में वापस; कम वज़न scrap बुक होता है) या **Roll finished** (core का बचा हिस्सा scrap) से निकलता है। बिना छुआ roll सीधे हटाया जा सकता है।
- Pause हमेशा कारण माँगता है (Machine breakdown, Maintenance, Material shortage, Manpower shortage, Power failure, Other) और downtime दर्ज करता है। "Other" में टिप्पणी ज़रूरी।
- आखिरी pouching step पर output दर्ज करते ही घर में बने (in-house) inner pouch स्टॉक से कटते हैं (गिनती से, या KG में रखे inner pouch वज़न से)। खरीदे हुए inner pouch यहाँ सिर्फ़ mark होते हैं; वे और बाकी हर packing सामान शाम की packing गिनती से बुक होते हैं। Inner pouch की setup से output कभी नहीं रुकता: pieces per inner pouch न हो तो भी output सेव होता है, Packing Yard "Inner packs filled" भरता है और शाम की गिनती उन्हें बुक करती है।
- रिलीज़ के बाद WC terminal पर तैयारी लॉक हो जाती है। "Recalculate from masters" केवल तब चलता है जब कोई output दर्ज न हुआ हो।

## Ink control

Ink job की requirement नहीं है। यह स्टोर से फ्लोर लोकेशन पर issue होती है, वापस या मिक्स (POLY या PET बेस) के रूप में लौटती है, और फ्लोर पर समय के साथ गिनी जाती है। असली खपत = शुरुआती गिनती + issue − वापसी − आखिरी गिनती। "Reconcile" टैब इसे उस समय छपे jobs पर बाँटता है और artwork GSM theory से मिलाता है।

## कौन क्या करता है

- **WORK_CENTER_MANAGER**: WC terminal — machine, rolls, granule codes, रिलीज़, अगला roll, close short, cancel। Machine terminal भी।
- **OPERATOR**: केवल machine terminal — start, output, pause, complete, roll वापस या खत्म।
- **PLANNER / PLANT_MANAGER**: फ्लोर स्क्रीन, ink control और job सार देख सकते हैं।
- **ADMIN / OWNER / SUPER_ADMIN**: सब कुछ।

## समस्याएँ और समाधान

- **"No Machines Assigned"** — खाते में machine या work centre नहीं। Admin System › Users पर assign करे।
- **Start बंद है** — input rolls reserve नहीं। WCM से कहें।
- **"Machine not assigned. WCM must assign a machine before execution."** — job किसी machine पर रिलीज़ नहीं हुआ।
- **"… is running JOB-…"** — पहले दूसरे order को pause या पूरा करें।
- **वेस्टेज कारण ज़रूरी** — Trim and scrap में कारण चुनें और लिखें क्यों।
- **"Load the next roll for this lane first."** — lane कम है; अगला roll जोड़ें।
- **"Selected roll width is outside the planned web ±20 mm …"** — दूसरा roll चुनें, चौड़े को slit करें, या कारण के साथ override।
- **"Code split for … must total …"** — grade codes का जोड़ issued kg के बराबर हो।
- **पीला "Output logged · one thing left for the store"** — output सेव है; स्टोर या शाम की गिनती स्टॉक नोट ठीक करेगी।

# Factory module (factory set-up)

The Factory module describes the physical factory: plants, stock locations, processes, work centres and machines. Everything on the floor — rolls, WC terminals, machine terminals, QR posters, costing — hangs on these masters.

## Screens

- **/factory** — "Factory Administration". Counts of plants, work centres, machines and locations, and cards to each set-up screen.
- **/factory/overview** — "Visual Factory". Live floor: machines by route stage, WIP pools with ageing, customer commitments, output, scrap, downtime, alerts.
- **/factory/plants** — plants with legal profile (legal name, GSTIN, address, phone, email, authorised signatory, designation), default cost group and "Include In Official Reports".
- **/factory/locations** — stock locations per plant. Types: Warehouse, Raw Materials, Quality Control, WIP Area, Finished Goods, Dispatch Area. System locations cannot be deleted.
- **/factory/processes** — process physics: input/output form (Bulk, Roll, None), roll behaviour (Create New, Modify Existing, Multi Input Combine, Split), allowed stock forms (open web, lay-flat tube, folded web), output stock-form mode, and route skip capability.
- **/factory/work-centers** — machine groups per plant with their processes and default cost group.
- **/factory/machines** — machines per work centre, cost group override, "Orders running at the same time", QR code.

## Set-up order

1. **Plants** — create the plant, fill the legal profile (it prints on slips and challans) and the default cost group.
2. **Locations** — create store, WIP, finished goods and dispatch locations, plus floor locations for ink.
3. **Processes** — define each process. Choose the roll behaviour carefully: it cannot change after creation.
4. **Work centres** — create e.g. "Printing" under the plant and tick its processes.
5. **Machines** — create e.g. "PRN-01" under the work centre. Leave "Orders running at the same time" on "By step type (default)" unless the owner says otherwise.
6. **Users** — on System › Users assign work centres to work-centre managers and machines to operators.
7. **QR posters** — print from the machine row or Maintenance › Machine QR; scanning opens the machine card.

## Rules and limits

- Machine codes must be unique across the factory ("Machine code '…' already belongs to … in …").
- Cost group precedence: machine override → work centre default → plant default.
- Whether a step's output is WIP or finished goods is decided by its position in the route, not by the process.
- Process stock forms are used by the machine screens and roll picker to filter, warn and block rolls.
- "Planner can make optional" and "WCM can skip after previous output" are only process-level ceilings; each route step still has its own setting.
- System processes cannot be edited or deleted; a process used by templates or jobs cannot be deleted.
- Delete is permanent. Masters with stock, jobs or history cannot be deleted; keep them.
- Machine status (ACTIVE / DOWN) is driven by maintenance faults and repairs, not by this page. Only ACTIVE machines appear on the machine selector.

## Visual Factory

The head shows how many machines run, are in changeover, down or idle. Tabs: Overview, Plants, Customer commitments. OEE is shown as two real numbers, Availability (A) and Quality (Q); Performance is not tracked. Open orders are bucketed Fresh 0-2 days, Watch 3-5 days, Aged 6+ days. Clicking a machine opens its live console.

## Who does what

- **ADMIN / OWNER / SUPER_ADMIN**: create and change plants, locations, processes, work centres and machines.
- **PLANNER, PLANT_MANAGER, WORK_CENTER_MANAGER**: open Factory Administration and Visual Factory; the set-up screens stay closed unless they have a factory permission.
- **OPERATOR**: no factory screens.

## Problems and fixes

- **A machine is missing on the machine selector** — it is not ACTIVE, is in another work centre, or is not assigned to the operator.
- **A work centre is missing on the WC terminal list** — assign it to the manager on System › Users.
- **"roll_behavior is immutable after process creation."** — create a new process instead.
- **Delete fails** — the record is in use; keep it or move the stock first.
- **Wrong company details on a slip** — fix the plant legal profile.
- **Visual Factory shows "No machines yet"** — set up work centres and machines for that plant.

- Cost group का क्रम: machine override → work centre default → plant default।
- Step का output WIP है या finished goods, यह route में उसकी जगह से तय होता है, process से नहीं।
- Process के stock forms से machine screens और roll picker rolls छाँटते, चेतावनी देते और रोकते हैं।
- "Planner can make optional" और "WCM can skip after previous output" केवल process स्तर की सीमा हैं; हर route step की अपनी सेटिंग भी होती है।
- System processes बदले या हटाए नहीं जा सकते; templates या jobs में इस्तेमाल हुआ process हटाया नहीं जा सकता।
- हटाना स्थायी है। जिन masters में स्टॉक, jobs या इतिहास है वे नहीं हटते; उन्हें रहने दें।
- Machine की स्थिति (ACTIVE / DOWN) मेंटेनेंस के fault और repair से बदलती है, इस पेज से नहीं। machine selector पर केवल ACTIVE machines आती हैं।

## Visual Factory

हेडर बताता है कितनी machines चल रही हैं, changeover में हैं, DOWN हैं या खाली हैं। टैब: Overview, Plants, Customer commitments। OEE दो असली नंबरों में दिखता है, Availability (A) और Quality (Q); Performance ट्रैक नहीं होता। खुले orders Fresh 0-2 days, Watch 3-5 days, Aged 6+ days में बँटते हैं। machine पर क्लिक करने से उसका लाइव console खुलता है।

## कौन क्या करता है

- **ADMIN / OWNER / SUPER_ADMIN**: plants, locations, processes, work centres और machines बनाना और बदलना।
- **PLANNER, PLANT_MANAGER, WORK_CENTER_MANAGER**: Factory Administration और Visual Factory खोल सकते हैं; सेट-अप स्क्रीन factory अनुमति के बिना नहीं खुलतीं।
- **OPERATOR**: कोई factory स्क्रीन नहीं।

## समस्याएँ और समाधान

- **Machine selector पर machine नहीं दिखती** — वह ACTIVE नहीं, दूसरे work centre में है, या operator को नहीं दी गई।
- **WC terminal सूची में work centre नहीं** — System › Users पर manager को assign करें।
- **"roll_behavior is immutable after process creation."** — नया process बनाएँ।
- **हटाना नहीं होता** — record इस्तेमाल में है; रहने दें या पहले स्टॉक हटाएँ।
- **Slip पर गलत कंपनी विवरण** — plant की legal profile ठीक करें।
- **Visual Factory में "No machines yet"** — उस प्लांट के work centres और machines बनाएँ।

# Inventory — stock views, corrections and documents (part A)

This part of the Inventory module covers the stock overview screens, stock corrections and alerts, and the paper that comes in or goes out of the factory gate that is not production stock: bills, general receipts, gate passes and the goods in & out register. Rolls, packaging, GRN, ledger, stock lifecycle, job work and inter-plant are covered in the other Inventory guide.

## Screens and how they connect
- **Stock workspace** (`/inventory`): home page. Tiles for bulk, active rolls and packaging; launcher tiles to Roll workspace, Stock conversion, Bulk & chemicals, Packaging, POD stock, Inks · adhesives · solvents, Roll genealogy and Inter-plant; a roll matrix (variant × thickness), bulk and packaging sections with drawers showing reservations. The top card "Gate bills waiting for inventory" links to Bills & documents.
- **Bulk & chemicals** (`/inventory/bulk`) and **Inks · adhesives · solvents** (`/inventory/addons`): filterable bulk stock with Pulse and Browse modes, saved views, export and a drawer with sales reservations and a "Stock card" link.
- **Bulk Transactions** (`/inventory/bulk-transactions`): read-only log of every bulk movement (Inward, Consumption, Transfer, Adjustment).
- **Stock Adjustments** (`/inventory/adjustments`, `/new`, `/[id]`): controlled corrections with maker-checker.
- **Alerts Center** (`/inventory/alerts`): stock problems found by the nightly check.
- **Count at rack** (`/inventory/count`): old link; it opens Stock lifecycle → Stock count.
- **Bills & documents** (`/inventory/gate-bills`, `/[id]`, `/[id]/view`): every incoming bill, classified and finished.
- **General receipts** (`/inventory/general-receipts`, `/new`, `/[id]`): non-stock receipts and machine history.
- **Gate passes** (`/inventory/gate-passes`, `/new`, `/[id]`): RGP / NRGP.
- **Goods in & out** (`/inventory/goods-movements`): one register of inter-plant, job work and gate passes by stage.

## Main flows
**1. A bill arrives.** The watchman photographs it at the gate (or the office presses "Upload bill"). It lands in the Inbox under "Needs classifying". Store opens it, chooses Document type and Category, types vendor, bill number, date and amounts, and presses "Save details". The Next step depends on the category: Stock items → "Open GRN" (stock goes up); Job work → "Receive job work"; Spares, Machinery, Service → "Create general receipt" (no stock); Utility, Professional / statutory fee, Other expense → "File as record"; Transport → "Attach to the stock bill" or file. A bill with some receipts stays "Partly received" until someone presses "Confirm all lines received". Duplicate bills (same vendor, bill number and financial year) are flagged; void them as "Duplicate".

**2. A general receipt.** From the bill, choose Goods or Service, add lines (Qty × Rate = Amount, GST %), say what happened (kept in store, installed, used) and the machine. Tick "This receipt completes the bill" only when every line is covered. Owner/Admin can reverse a receipt with a reason; it is never deleted.

**3. A part goes out for repair.** Create a gate pass (RGP, purpose Repair, expected back date, items, machine). "Save and issue" gives the number; print it. The watchman scans the QR and the pass shows "Out of factory". When it returns with a bill, record a General Receipt and tick "Came back on a returnable gate pass (RGP)"; without a bill use "Receive back". If it will not return, "Short-close" with a reason. NRGP (scrap sale, sample, return to supplier) closes when it leaves.

**4. A stock correction.** Draft a New stock adjustment: plant, reason, lines with a plus or minus delta in the item's stock unit. "Save Draft". A second person with the adjust right opens it and presses "Post" — stock and ledger change. A wrong posted adjustment is voided; voiding posts inverse lines.

**5. Alerts.** The nightly check raises alerts (negative stock, ledger mismatch, weight mismatch, orphan roll, stuck WIP, low stock). Fix the cause with a count or adjustment, then "Resolve" with a note. Mismatch alerts close themselves the night after the cause is fixed.

## Rules and limits
- Only stock bills (GRN) and job-work receipts change inventory. General receipts, gate passes, filed bills and "Mark back at gate" never move stock.
- Stock adjustments need two people unless the poster is Owner or Admin. Quantities are in the item's base unit; rolls in KG. A roll can be adjusted only when AVAILABLE (or MISSING with a plus) and not reserved for a job. Job-work, transit and scrap locations cannot be adjusted. A material held under several quality codes at one location must be corrected through a physical count.
- Office uploads: up to 20 files / 20 pages, photo 10 MB, PDF 15 MB, JPEG/PNG/WebP/PDF.
- A returnable gate pass needs an expected return date not in the past; scrap sale is NRGP only.
- A General Receipt that brought gate-pass items back cannot be reversed.
- Every save on bills, receipts and passes is retry-safe: pressing the same button again after a network drop never records twice.

## Who does what
- **STORE**: classifies bills, posts GRNs, records general receipts, raises gate passes, drafts and posts adjustments (as second person), resolves alerts.
- **OWNER / ADMIN / SUPER_ADMIN**: everything, plus reopening filed or voided bills, reversing general receipts, self-posting adjustments and seeing document storage.
- **PLANNER, WORK_CENTER_MANAGER**: view stock workspaces, alerts and transactions.
- **PLANT_MANAGER**: stock views, adjustments, alerts, goods in & out.
- **DISPATCH**: Goods in & out.
- **WATCHMAN**: photographs bills and scans gate-pass QR at the gate; never sees these office screens.

## Problems and fixes
- *"A stock adjustment needs a second person…"*: you drafted it; another user must post. After "Save & Post" fails this way, the draft already exists — do not press again.
- *"…would make stock negative"*: the minus is more than the stock; recount.
- *"Someone else saved this document…"*: reload values, check, save again.
- *Bill cannot be filed*: choose a record-only category first.
- *Bill cannot be voided*: receipts are linked; confirm it complete instead.
- *"Only … is still out on …"*: you entered more than is still out on the RGP line.
- *Upload not confirmed*: press "Send the same upload again".
- *Alerts page empty but problems expected*: press "Refresh"; load errors are not shown.

# Inventory — receiving, moving, counting and closing stock (part B)

This part of the Inventory module covers how stock **comes in** (Smart GRN and its history), how it **moves and changes form** (roll workspace, stock conversion, roll movements, inter-plant transfers, job work), how it is **traced** (roll genealogy, ledger), how departures are **matched to papers** (outward documents), and how stock is **counted and closed** (Count and close: opening stock, stock count, evening packing count, month end, year end). Vendors and the packaging stock view also sit here. Bulk, inks and other stock screens are described in the other Inventory guide.

## Screens and how they connect

- **Receive goods (Smart GRN)** `/inventory/grn` — one form per supplier invoice. Pick the stock class (Bulk material, Film roll, Packaging, Trading goods), the source (Against system PO, Manual vendor PO ref, Direct receipt), vendor, invoice and receiving warehouse, enter the lines and press **Submit & post** (Ctrl/⌘+Enter). Rolls use a fast grid: each new line starts as a copy of the one above, so only weights change; gross − tare fills net. Large lots can be pasted from Excel or uploaded with the live template. When a gate bill exists, open it from Bills & documents so the bill sits beside the form and is linked in the same save.
- **GRN history & corrections** `/inventory/grn-history` — every inward row with filters and CSV export. A wrong row is fixed with **Correct**: the original stays locked and a correction entry stores before, after, delta, user and reason. Closed-year rows are read-only.
- **Roll workspace** `/inventory/rolls` — the store home page: film board (Free, Reserved, On machine, Away), variant × thickness matrix, table and cards, with filters for status, role, form, plant, location, age and size. Roll detail links to lineage, stock card and labels.
- **Stock conversion** `/inventory/stock-conversions` — slit an open-web jumbo, open a tube to one or two sheets, fold or unfold. Weight is kept and the parent → child genealogy is recorded.
- **Roll movements** `/inventory/movements` and **Ledger** `/inventory/ledger` — read-only lists of recent roll moves and of bulk transactions plus roll moves.
- **Roll genealogy** `/inventory/traceability` — scan or type a roll's ERP ID or supplier number and see its tree, timeline and physical moves.
- **Inter-plant transfers** `/inventory/inter-plant` — challan per transfer: Draft → In Transit → Received, with a printable PDF and QR gate sticker (`/inventory/inter-plant/print/[id]`).
- **Job work** `/inventory/job-work` and `/inventory/job-work/[id]` — orders to outside job workers, Rule 45 challans with QR, returns with a material-balance check, bill linking, continue production with a part return, close or close short.
- **Outward documents** `/inventory/outward-documents` — the watchman's departure photos waiting to be matched to ERP challans, invoices or gate passes; the match screen and a pop-out photo window for a second monitor.
- **Packaging materials** `/inventory/packaging` — stock of inner pouches, gonny, cartons, tape, sheet, labels, tags and POD sleeves, with today's evening-count figures.
- **Count and close** `/inventory/stock-lifecycle` — Overview, Opening stock, Stock count (with the evening packing count), Month end, Year end. The old `/inventory/period` opens its Year end tab; the old `/inventory/ink-floor` opens Ink control.
- **Vendors** `/inventory/vendors` — suppliers, job workers and service providers. Status, job-work processes, plants and rate cards are edited in Master data → Vendors.

## Main flows

**Receiving a supplier delivery.** 1) The watchman photographs the bill at the gate; 2) the store classifies it in Bills & documents and opens Receive; 3) Smart GRN opens with the bill beside it; 4) the store enters what was actually received and posts; 5) rolls appear in the roll workspace as Available, bulk and packaging in their stock views; 6) a mistake is corrected in GRN history, never by posting a second GRN.

**Sending work to a job worker.** 1) Create the order (Planned route step, or Emergency handoff with a reason); 2) Send material issues a numbered challan with a QR, which the gate scans; 3) when goods return, Receive: mark each sent roll used up, came back unused or partly used, enter output and wastage, and check the material balance; 4) if production must start with a part return, Continue production with what's back completes the route step; 5) Close when nothing is left (or Close short with a reason). Overdue alerts start after "Expected back by"; material held 300+ days is flagged for GST ITC-04.

**Moving stock between plants.** Create the inter-plant challan, dispatch it (stock sits in the source plant's IN_TRANSIT), print it with the QR sticker, and receive it at the destination into a target location. Open challans block the year-end close.

**Evening packing count.** In-house inner pouches leave stock at the machine's last pouching step when the output is logged; the Packing Yard never takes inner pouches off stock. Bought inner pouches are only marked by the machine, and every other packing item (gonny, sheet/putha, box, tape, label, tag, outer bag, other) is only ticked at release — no quantity. In the evening the store opens Count and close → Stock count → Evening packing count and picks the location. Each row starts filled with the book quantity; change only the items whose count differs and press Post count. It posts at once, with no approval, and rows left at the book figure do not change stock. The shortfall is booked to the orders that ticked or marked that item that day, shared in whole pieces; if no one did, to that day's orders whose packing plan includes the item, and only when there are none does it stay on no order. An excess is posted as count excess. Packing audit shows each count with book → counted → used and each order's share.

**Stock count and close.** Stock count is one count for any day: month end, a period or a spot check. Choose the scope and count mode, enter what is on the floor, give a reason for every difference of 2% or more and press Post physical count. Month end takes the month's snapshot and proof (reporting only). Year end checks the blockers, locks the year, generates next year's opening and archives the year's finished records.

## Rules and limits

- Only active vendors of type Raw Material or Hybrid can supply a GRN; the same invoice number cannot be received twice for one vendor.
- GRNs into virtual locations are refused; the plant comes from the receiving warehouse.
- Roll gross must equal net + tare within 0.05 kg; extrudable film needs a grade.
- Rolls are never edited directly: weight, status and location change only through receipts, production, dispatch, job work, moves, conversions and adjustments.
- Only Available rolls can be converted or sent to another plant; reserved rolls must be released first.
- Job-work returns are never received on Smart GRN.
- Matching outward papers never moves stock or marks delivery.
- Closed financial years cannot change; corrections in a closed year need an FY correction.
- A count sheet sent for approval (Submit → Approve in Count history) needs a different checker; only an owner may approve their own. "Post physical count" and the evening packing count post at once, with no approval.

## Who does what

- **STORE:** GRN, corrections, conversions, inter-plant challans, job work, outward matching, counts, evening packing count.
- **PLANNER:** looks at rolls, job work and history; creates job-work orders for planned steps.
- **WORK_CENTER_MANAGER:** rolls, conversions, inter-plant, genealogy.
- **PLANT_MANAGER:** counts, ledger, vendors, Count and close.
- **OWNER / ADMIN:** everything, including approving counts, voiding outward records, settling old job-work rolls and closing the year.

## Problems and fixes

- *"Duplicate vendor invoice"* — the invoice was already received; check GRN history and correct the old GRN.
- *"GRN vendor must be RM or BOTH type"* — fix the vendor type.
- *A roll is missing from a picker* — it is reserved, quarantined, in process or at another plant; trace it in Roll genealogy.
- *"Material balance is off"* on job work — recheck the weights or write the reason.
- *Year end will not close* — read the blockers: receive in-transit challans, close job-work orders, post or cancel draft sheets, fix negative bulk stock, resolve critical alerts.
- *Packing stock looks wrong* — compare Packing audit → Evening counts before adjusting; count again rather than adjusting by hand.
- *A save timed out* — on job work, press the same button again (retries are recognised); on Smart GRN, check GRN history first.

Example: the store receives invoice ACM/INV/2026-0098 from ABC Polymers for 12 rolls of 1050 mm, 50 micron film against PO-2026-0042, then sends 4 of them to a job worker for lamination on JWO-2026-0007 for SO-2026-0123.
